summary: Olson Mountain crow's nest lookout site, Jackson County, Oregon: built in the 1920s, still there in 1994, now in ruins; Oregon Dept. of Forestry listed as agency.

facts.status_note: Register says it was still there in 1994 and is now in ruins

events.note: Register and firelookout.com give only 'the 1920s'; 1920 is a placeholder for the decade
Still there in 1994 per the register and firelookout.com; the register adds that it is now in ruins, with no date for the ruin
Registered March 26, 2011, nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: built in the 1920s as a crow's nest lookout; still there in 1994; now in ruins
evidence.quote: Built in the 1920s, this crow's nest lookout was still there in 1994, but is now in ruins.

evidence.supports: agency is the Oregon Dept. of Forestry
agency is the Oregon Dept. of Forestry (firelookout.com)
site is 8 miles north of Butte Falls

corrections.why: The register says the lookout is now in ruins, so the record should use the ruins status (footings or remains only), not gone

notes_for_editor: Two sources, both naming the Oregon Dept. of Forestry, with no staffing record and no access information. No source gives a date for the ruins or describes the site today. A Grokipedia.com page on the mountain says BLM administers the land; it is an encyclopedia mirror, not a primary source, so it was not used. Editor may want to confirm the administering agency with ODF or BLM before publishing. The brief's agency entry is correct.
